== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Wolves are a specialized division or group of warriors characterized by their use of combat techniques that manipulate Way{{!}}the Way to empower physical strikes with the weight of universal laws. Members of this group often wear armor featuring a stylized wolf head symbol, with some individuals wearing white armor and possessing scarlet eyes. The group is organized into a hierarchy of stars, such as one-star, two-star, and three-star ranks, which correlate to their level of power and progression. They function as instruments of battle by honing their bodies to allow Way{{!}}the Way to reinforce their combat abilities. Within this organization, individuals can possess a unique [[Presence]], though standard-issue versions may lack distinct personalities. The Wolves maintain professional connections with other groups, such as the spiders{{!}}Spiders, and are considered formidable opponents capable of engaging in significant combat.}}
